# Homebrew Tap for LocalRouter

This tap publishes the localrouter formula for LocalRouter.

## Install

    brew tap AruNi-01/homebrew-tap
    brew install localrouter

Or in a single command:

    brew install AruNi-01/homebrew-tap/localrouter

## Upgrade

    brew update
    brew upgrade localrouter

## Verify

    localrouter daemon status

## Project

- Source repo: https://github.com/AruNi-01/local-router
- Current formula version: 0.1.0
